application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1 - Horse Chestnut - Raise the lower branches by 1.5 metres over the access road and mixed shrubbery border, pruning secondary branches only.

Tree height 16 metres, crown spread 9 metres. Maximum pruning cut diameter approximately 5 cm.

Reasons - To raise the crown for high sided vehicle access, over the access road and balancing of lower crown over the shrubbery.

T2 - London Plane - Prune back the side lateral branches form the building by approximately 1.5 metres to where the previous pruning points are located. Remove a single limb due to decay, approximately 20cm diameter. This limb located on same side of the canopy, growing int he direction of the buildings and over driveway/car parking areas.

Tree height 20 metres, crown spread 12 metres, Maximum pruning cut diameter on limb reduction work approximately 8 cm, diameter of decayed limb to be removed approximately 20m.


Reasons - The canopy side growing towards the buildings has been historically reduced, pruning to maintain clearance form building. Decayed limb to be removed to reduce hazard over car parking/Driveway area.
